# What do you really make on a pound of honey?

> Free calculator for backyard beekeepers who sell honey: what a pound costs you, how many hours it takes, your profit per pound and per hour, the price per pound you need to earn a wage, and what a poor honey year and winter hive losses do to it. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/backyard-honey-profit-calculator/)
